title: Scan producer diff for disallowed emails in-loop; match refusals in
summary: Retry of job 20261027-054305-mgvj (dispatched, never verified, no findings recorded). Run admission's email allow-list scan on the producer's working diff inside the producer loop, so a disallowed address fails the run naming file:line. Add one producer-prompt line on identities. Make introspection's earlier-case search match the admission refusal reason, so repeats of jobs 20261013-135309-9e8t and 20261015-014012-akwq are not recorded as new classes.

defaults_applied.how: New tests plus fmt, clippy and test criteria.
Criteria run tests that exercise the scan and the matcher.
All changes are Rust and one prompt line.
One focused change reusing admission's rule.
The rule is enforced by an in-loop scan, not only prose.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-core/src/admission.rs (the email allow-list refusal near line 400, message '<path> adds an email address outside the allow-list') and crates/athena-core/src/introspect.rs (narrow_cases at ~841, apply_answer at ~1453). The producer loop lives in crates/athena-core/src/run/ (mod.rs, producer.rs, send_back.rs, candidate.rs). No new record or data file is added, so check_record_file, AnyRecord and the round-trip test are not affected. The behavior is measured directly by cargo test -p athena-core tests that drive the producer loop and the introspect matcher.

Job 20261027-054305-mgvj addressed: its work is retried from base. Its 12 changed files are all kept as deliverables, including run/producer.rs and run/send_back.rs, which the earlier scope omitted. No findings were recorded, so the earlier approach is redone: an in-loop scan reusing admission's rule and allow-list, one send-back, then failure with file:line.

Root causes to name in comments or commit text: (1) no in-loop scan, so the producer learned of the address only at admission; (2) narrow_cases/apply_answer did not match on the admission refusal reason, so earlier cases were not found.
Audience: the maintainer who judges producer runs and introspection records. Mirror the earlier accepted reading.
Prompt budget: the producer (change) set has 146 tokens left; the single added line fits.

acceptance_criteria.text: Run cargo test -p athena-core: a new test gives the producer a working diff adding a disallowed email on a known line of a known file and asserts the run fails with a message naming that file and line; it fails on base code and passes with the change.

Run cargo test -p athena-core: a test with an allow-listed address, or none, in the working diff asserts the producer run is not failed by the new scan. An address already present in the base is not blamed.

Run cargo test -p athena-core: a new introspect test builds records where two earlier jobs' outcomes record 'adds an email address outside the allow-list', and asserts the narrowed earlier-case list for a new event with that refusal includes both. It also asserts the resulting introspection record has non-empty earlier_cases and new_class is false. It fails on base code.
crates/athena-cap-change/prompts/producer.md contains one new line saying identities come from config or git settings, never from literals in code (Grep for 'literals').
Code comments or commit text name both root causes: no in-loop scan, and narrow_cases/apply_answer not matching on the admission refusal reason. CHANGELOG.md has an entry.
Run cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings, and cargo test; all pass.

The change refuses more producer runs than before by design: expected 5% of newly refused readings; the higher rate is intended because it moves the existing admission email refusal earlier and adds no new rule.

out_of_scope: The athena land --pr work from job 20261013-135309-9e8t (gh.rs, pr.rs, land.rs and its other files): dropped, not redone here
The audience role from job 20261015-014012-akwq (audience.rs, roles.rs, athena.toml [audience], and its other files): dropped, not redone here
Changes to athena.toml, defaults.toml, or CI workflows

departures: Slightly higher cost and lower pass odds than the reference: the previous attempt of this job was never verified, and the change spans the run loop and introspection.
hard_reason: Adds an in-loop refusal rule that can fail producer runs and changes the run pipeline and introspection matching.
